Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed methodology. We begin by assessing the quality of the original code review dataset (RQ1 ) using an evaluation framework and an LLM-as-a-Judge setup. Two curation pipelines are then applied to produce CuREV and CuREV+. We evaluate their quality (RQ2 ), diversity (RQ3 ), and their impact on two downstream tasks: comment generation (RQ4 ) and code refinement (RQ5 ).
